title: AI in Everyday Life

video_prompt.subject: Three children in separate cinematic split-screen panels, each interacting with AI in a unique daily-life moment

action.panel_1: A girl speaks into her phone as a voice AI assistant instantly translates a difficult English word into simple glowing English definitions floating above the screen
action.panel_2: A boy uses an AI art generator on a tablet to create a stunning symmetrical digital pattern inspired by traditional floor art, with animated glowing design lines forming in real time
action.panel_3: A young student lies in bed under warm blankets while an AI storyteller device reads a bedtime story aloud, projecting soft animated storybook stars and floating characters into the room

video_prompt.setting: Dynamic triple split-screen layout showing three vibrant environments: cozy study corner, colorful art desk workspace, and warm softly lit bedroom at night

background_elements.panel_1: Bookshelf, notebook, glowing phone reflections, floating translated word bubbles
background_elements.panel_2: Stylus pen, sketch papers, animated art particles, glowing pattern grid on desk
background_elements.panel_3: Night lamp glow, floating storybook sparkles, plush toys, dreamy projected stars on ceiling

video_prompt.camera_movement: Smooth animated transitions between panels with flowing digital swipe effects, gentle zoom-ins on each child during key emotional moments
video_prompt.cinematic_effects: Holographic floating text, glowing AI interface particles, spark trails between panel transitions, soft bloom lighting and magical ambient overlays
video_prompt.color_grade: Vibrant cinematic palette with warm saffron, vivid green, and luminous blue tones across the three panels
video_prompt.style: Playful, energetic, colorful, cinematic, emotionally engaging, realistic with magical futuristic touches
creative_enhancements: Floating English translation words appear as glowing holograms in panel one
AI-generated artwork builds itself in luminous animated strokes in panel two
Storybook characters softly materialize as glowing projections in panel three
Digital light ribbons sweep between panels to connect all three AI experiences seamlessly

voiceover.text: Translation, art, stories — AI helps in everything.
voiceover.delivery_style: Bright, cheerful, inspiring narrator tone with playful emphasis on each keyword

audio.sfx: Playful digital whoosh transitions, soft interface chimes, magical sparkle sounds during AI interactions
audio.music: Upbeat modern digital orchestral background with playful rhythmic energy and warm melodic accents

emotion: Playful energy, wonder, creativity, joyful discovery

visual_symbolism.theme: AI as a creative companion in everyday life
symbolic_elements: Floating translated words symbolize accessible knowledge
Glowing digital art patterns represent creativity enhanced by AI
Projected bedtime story visuals symbolize imagination brought to life through technology
